Infobox for structure pages, built on [[Module:Infobox]] (DRUID). Every parameter is optional; empty rows are hidden. Labels are translated automatically from [[Module:Labels/data]]. Without <code>image</code> it shows <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> when that file exists, or the placeholder otherwise, so uploading <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> is enough to replace it.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Infobox Structure
|title=
|image=
|caption=
|quote=
|Dimension=
|Biome=
|Location=
|Locate=
|Inhabitants=
|Purpose=
|Protection=
}}
</pre>
